before.note: V2 default calendar_month plans one required segment per month from 2010-01-04. Vendor API is next-business-day / recent-only (pagination_key). 199 PARTIAL months are missing-receipt inventory, not 199 missing source months.

quotes: This API returns information about stocks whose financial results will be announced on the next business day.
It will be updated at around 19:00 (JST) only when there is an update for companies which end their fiscal year in March or September at the following site.
If you need scheduled announcement dates and publication history for all listed issues (including REITs), please use the Earnings Announcement Dates API.
official_evidence.plan_data_period: Earnings Calendar (March/September fiscal year-end only): Recent data only (all plans)

change_reason: Vendor product is a next-business-day snapshot, not a monthly history series. Required inventory is issued collection windows at cutoff, evaluated via collection generation / cutoff / freshness SLA. Do not plan 200 calendar months from 2010. Do not mint empty COMPLETE for those months. Historical announcement dates route to fins_earnings_date.

excluded_vendor_tip_only.reason: False-PARTIAL calendar-month inventory against a next-business-day snapshot API. Months without Mar/Sep FY next-day announcements are not source gaps.

remaining_genuine_gaps.note: 199 monthly PARTIAL were false-PARTIAL. Vendor Mar/Sep FY and REIT limits are product bounds; history uses fins_earnings_date. A cutoff without a trusted SUCCESS receipt stays PARTIAL for that snapshot window and must not be filled with empty COMPLETE.
